name: Soybean Crush Spread: Does Elevated March Mean-Revert Into Q2?
description: Tests whether elevated soybean crush spreads in March predict mean-reversion into Q2. Uses CBOT board crush formula (ZM×44/2000 + ZL×11/100 − ZS/100). March readings above historical median (percentrank > 50) are classified as "elevated." Forward spread changes at +21d (April) and +63d (full Q2) are compared between elevated and normal March regimes. BackwardPanamaCanal adjustment preserves dollar spread integrity across contract rolls.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread: Does Elevated March Mean-Revert Into Q2?
# CBOT Board Crush: ZM×44/2000 + ZL×11/100 − ZS/100 ($/bushel)
# Elevated = March crush above historical median (percentrank > 50)
# Forward windows: +21d (April) and +63d (full Q2)

# --- Data ---
ts = index()().value

# Primary asset: soybeans (ZS)
zs_raw = market_data_source()()
zs = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

# Reference: soybean meal (ZM) and soybean oil (ZL)
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# CBOT board crush: 44 lbs meal per bushel, 11 lbs oil per bushel
# ZM quoted in $/ton (short ton = 2000 lbs), ZL in cents/lb, ZS in cents/bushel
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)
zs_close = ffill(zs.c)
crush = (zm_close * 44.0 / 2000.0) + (zl_close * 11.0 / 100.0) - (zs_close / 100.0)

# --- March Detection & Classification ---
is_march = month_of_year(month=Month.March)().result

# Historical percentile rank of crush spread (252-day lookback ~ 1 year)
crush_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(crush).result

# Elevated = above historical median during March
is_elevated_march = is_march and (is_valid(crush_pctrank) and crush_pctrank > 50.0)
is_normal_march = is_march and (is_valid(crush_pctrank) and crush_pctrank <= 50.0)

# --- Forward Spread Changes ($/bushel change, NOT % return — avoids S46 div-by-zero) ---
fwd_21d_change = (crush << 21) - crush
fwd_63d_change = (crush << 63) - crush

# Filter forward changes by March regime
elev_fwd_21d = where(is_elevated_march, fwd_21d_change)
elev_fwd_63d = where(is_elevated_march, fwd_63d_change)
norm_fwd_21d = where(is_normal_march, fwd_21d_change)
norm_fwd_63d = where(is_normal_march, fwd_63d_change)

# Hit rate: % of times spread DECLINED (mean-reversion = negative change)
elev_hit_21d = 1.0 if (is_valid(elev_fwd_21d) and elev_fwd_21d < 0) else 0.0
elev_hit_63d = 1.0 if (is_valid(elev_fwd_63d) and elev_fwd_63d < 0) else 0.0
norm_hit_21d = 1.0 if (is_valid(norm_fwd_21d) and norm_fwd_21d < 0) else 0.0
norm_hit_63d = 1.0 if (is_valid(norm_fwd_63d) and norm_fwd_63d < 0) else 0.0

# --- Event Marker helpers (defined BEFORE event_marker call) ---
regime_label = conditional_select(is_elevated_march, 'Elevated', is_normal_march, 'Normal', 'N/A')
is_march_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.start, month_anchor=3)(ts).value

# --- Output 1: CONTEXT — Crush spread over time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread ($/bushel)',
    category='Crush Spread Q2 Mean-Reversion',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=crush)

# --- Output 2: PUNCHLINE — Elevated vs Normal March forward changes ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Elevated March Crush Mean-Revert Into Q2?',
    category='Crush Spread Q2 Mean-Reversion',
    y_axis_label='Median Spread Change ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+21d (Apr)', color=Color.Blue, stack='Elevated March'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+63d (Q2)', color=Color.Blue, stack='Elevated March'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+21d (Apr)', color=Color.Slate, stack='Normal March'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+63d (Q2)', color=Color.Slate, stack='Normal March')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='No Change')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(elev_fwd_21d, elev_fwd_63d, norm_fwd_21d, norm_fwd_63d))

# --- Output 3: REFERENCE — Stats table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Crush Spread Q2 Mean-Reversion',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='March Crush → Q2 Forward Change Stats',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Elevated +21d', 'Elevated +63d', 'Normal +21d', 'Normal +63d'],
        col_headers=['N (March Days)', 'Median ($/bu)', 'Reversion Rate', 'Worst ($/bu)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(elev_fwd_21d, elev_fwd_21d, elev_hit_21d, elev_fwd_21d, elev_fwd_63d, elev_fwd_63d, elev_hit_63d, elev_fwd_63d, norm_fwd_21d, norm_fwd_21d, norm_hit_21d, norm_fwd_21d, norm_fwd_63d, norm_fwd_63d, norm_hit_63d, norm_fwd_63d)

# --- Event Markers: One per March start showing regime + forward outcomes ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='March Crush Regime',
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+21d Chg', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='+63d Chg', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, crush, crush_pctrank, fwd_21d_change, fwd_63d_change, is_march_start)
